prompt:
Repo: this directory (static site). Plan: specs/2-share-previews/plan.md; spec: specs/2-share-previews/spec.md.

Your task: Task 4 only (R6). Create `404.html`: `<title>`, robots noindex, viewport meta, `<link rel="stylesheet" href="/portfolio-case-study.css">`, the nav/footer markup of the case-study pages (see projects/humanoid-eye.html), a short friendly message, links to `/` and `/#projects`. Every local URL must be root-absolute. You own only 404.html.
Acceptance: `python3 -m pytest -q tests -k "404 or broken"`.
`.claude/fast-test.sh` must be green when you finish (it already sets aside tests that belong to later tasks). Commit your work as one commit when done.

grader.command: git diff --quiet $(git rev-list --max-parents=0 HEAD) -- tests && python3 -m pytest -q tests -k '404 or broken'
